subject: Racer engine replacement
question: Direct owner request; no question was asked.
decision: Replace the Racer's engine with a far better kart-racing engine in the genre's manner (chase camera over a perspective ground, a raced circuit, pickups that raise speed and a basic item system), built only from Mermaid Roshan art and characters with no Nintendo art, names or other IP. Claude builds the engine; Codex produces all relevant artwork from a written handoff. This supersedes ODR-RACER-VIEW-20261018 (side-scrolling race).

subject: Racer touch interface
question: Direct owner instruction; no question was asked.
decision: The race is played with a touchscreen interface: a green control stick on the left, and on the right a red brake button plus a bubble button for items and boost.

subject: Track fidelity and reorganize-only art requests
question: Direct owner rule of thumb for the project; no question was asked.
decision: Race tracks must resemble the in-game settings with high accuracy. New art requests to Codex are allowed only as reorganizations of existing assets, never as genuinely new content.
